# 100% Free Website Offer - Techvunex Innovation

## What Is Included in the Free Website Offer (Deliverables)

1. Share Your Details: Send business details, logo, services, and required content.
2. Approve Website Structure: Review and approve page flow, layout, and sections.
3. Review the Website: Check design and provide revision requests (up to 2 rounds included).
4. Website Goes Live: Your business website is prepared and launched with 15 days of support.

## Free Business Website vs Custom Web Development Scope
- The 100% Free Website Offer covers a complete modern business website up to 5 standard pages with defined scope at ₹0 development fee.
- Custom Web Platforms, custom SaaS applications, complex e-commerce stores with multi-vendor checkouts, or advanced web portals fall outside the free basic offer. These are scoped separately as custom software projects with flexible payment options.

# Techvunex Payment Plans & Zero-Cost 12-Month EMI

Techvunex Innovation offers a client-friendly commercial payment model: Pay 25% upfront and the remaining 75% through zero-cost 12-month EMI.

## Payment Terms & Model Breakdown
- Pay 25% Upfront: Pay 25% advance at project kickoff to lock your timeline and begin development.
- Remaining 75% via Zero-Cost 12-Month EMI: Pay the remaining 75% balance after delivery through easy monthly installments over 12 months.
- 0% Interest (Zero-Cost EMI): No interest charges, no hidden fees, and easy monthly payments.

## Example Calculation
- For a ₹2 Lakh (₹200,000) project:
  - 25% Upfront = ₹50,000 advance at kickoff.
  - Remaining 75% = ₹1.5 Lakh (₹150,000) balance after delivery.
  - 12 Monthly Installments = ₹12,500 per month across 12 months at 0% interest.

## Scope & Pricing Policies
- Free Website Offer: Techvunex provides a modern 4-5 page business website at ₹0 development fee.
- Custom Projects (CRM, ERP, Mobile Apps, Custom SaaS, Complex E-Commerce): Quoted based on required features and project scope, and eligible for the 25% upfront + 75% 12-month zero-cost EMI plan.
- Terms: EMI eligibility and payment schedule may depend on project scope, approval, and agreed commercial terms.

title: Domain & Hosting Policy | Techvunex Innovation
description: Techvunex policy on domain registration, cloud hosting, client credentials ownership, and DNS/SSL setup.
content:
# Domain & Hosting Guidelines and Ownership Policy

Techvunex Innovation assists businesses with complete domain registration, server hosting setup, and cloud infrastructure deployment.

## Domain vs Hosting Explained
- Domain: Your website's unique digital address on the internet (e.g., yourcompany.com or yourbrand.in) that visitors type in their browser.
- Hosting: The secure server storage space where your website files, code, databases, and media reside so that the site is accessible online 24/7.

## 100% Client Ownership & Credentials Policy
- Full Client Ownership: The domain and hosting accounts are always 100% owned by the client. Techvunex NEVER locks client domains or retains proprietary hold over credentials.
- Client-Provided Setup: Clients can purchase their own domain and hosting through their preferred registrar (e.g., Hostinger, GoDaddy, Namecheap, AWS, Google Cloud) and provide access for configuration.
- Managed Setup Assistance: Alternatively, Techvunex's technical team can guide or manage the purchase directly in the client's name and set up DNS, nameservers, and SSL certificates at no extra technical configuration fee.

## 100% Free Website Offer Policy Regarding Domain & Hosting
- The ₹0 Free Website Offer covers complete end-to-end design, code development, WhatsApp integration, and form setup at zero development fee.
- Standard third-party infrastructure costs (domain registration and web hosting) are direct third-party services that belong to and are paid for by the client.

## Supported Hosting Platforms
- Enterprise & Scalable: AWS (Amazon Web Services), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure.
- Modern Web Platforms: Hostinger, Vercel, Netlify, DigitalOcean.
- Security & Performance: Free SSL (HTTPS) setup, Cloudflare CDN integration, and daily automated backups.
